---
title: Contribute to an existing book
---

Each handbook accepts corrections and proposals in its own repository.

1. Open the book's reading site and follow its source-repository link.
2. Open an issue for an error or proposal, or send a pull request.
3. The book's checks run and a maintainer reviews the change.
4. Accepted changes appear in the next release and then in this library.

To improve the toolkit, template or portal, contribute to the
[hub repository](https://github.com/cesarcastrocuba/handbooks-hub).
